items.quote: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
items.claim: Moses told the people all the words and judgments of the LORD, and the people answered with one voice that they would do everything the LORD had said.
items.action: told the people the words and judgments of the LORD; the people agreed with one voice to obey
items.object: all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments
items.mechanism: Moses told the people the words out loud, and the people agreed together, all at once
